Word count 640 is below the url-plan target_word_count of 800 for this hub

template_issues.title: Every audited page ships 1 render-blocking script and 1 render-blocking stylesheet (DataForSEO render_blocking_*_count). Not currently a Lighthouse failure on desktop, but it is the main mobile-scoring risk.

money_page_alerts.main_issue: title 29 chars (under 30), meta description 195 chars (over 160); Lighthouse perf 100, LCP 0.55s

environment_caveats: Audited the Cloudflare Pages staging preview; x-robots-tag: noindex is injected on all *.pages.dev responses (verified on /, /services/, /contact/). Lighthouse SEO is therefore pinned at 69 on every page via the is-crawlable audit. SEO is inconclusive - staging noindex artifact, re-audit after apex cutover. SEO was excluded from all verdicts.

Canonical tags on all 6 pages point to the future apex (https://desertvalleycontracting.net/...), so DataForSEO reports checks.canonical=false when crawled on the staging host. This is correct pre-cutover configuration, not a defect.

DataForSEO checks.has_micromarkup=false on all 6 pages is a false negative. Verified against raw HTML: every page ships exactly 1 application/ld+json block (LocalBusiness, Organization, WebSite, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, AggregateRating, PostalAddress, GeoCoordinates). No missing-schema issue was recorded.
The apex desertvalleycontracting.net currently still serves the previous Duda site (301 to www, server: nginx). Apex cutover has not happened.

Client record status is 'onboarding', not 'active' as the methodology pre-flight requires. build_status is 'pushed_main' so the site is live and auditable; proceeded on that basis, matching the precedent set by flood-solutions-inc.
Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (formFactor=desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). Mobile scores would typically run 10-20 performance points lower. These are not mobile-first scores.
TBT_ms and INP_ms are null: the MCP AI-mode Lighthouse digest does not return total-blocking-time or INP. Not invented.

regression.note: First audit for this client - no comparison data.
